image_description: A close-up, head-and-shoulders portrait of a small, brown mustelid (likely a weasel or stoat) facing slightly right. The animal has dense brown fur, small dark eyes, a pointed snout with a dark nose, and visible whiskers. The background is a plain, out-of-focus neutral tone. The lighting creates soft shadows on the right side of the face.

Both eyes are visible, small, round, and dark, matching the taxonomy description.
The ears are visible on the top of the head, appearing short and rounded, consistent with a weasel.
